stations.title: Marek
stations.say: Ängsö never got a February invoice.

stations.title: Invoice run
stations.text: One invoice a month, on the renewal date.

captions: At Wrenhaven Scores, Marek finds that a licence from 31 January skipped February.
The next invoice after 31 January goes out on 3 March, and February has none.
You catch it in a test, add months and days like a calendar, and test the edges.
Now every licence renews once a month, and follow-ups keep their time.
Same licence, same choir. February gets its invoice.
